description.html: Arcadia Revitalise'd3 is a complete vitamin and mineral powder supplement for reptiles and amphibians. It contains vitamin D3 together with a full spectrum of vitamins, minerals and trace elements needed for proper metabolism and healthy growth.

Dust it over live food several times a week as an addition to daily calcium. The formula supports the immune system, skin health and proper bone development, especially in young animals and species in a period of rapid growth.
Made by the British brand Arcadia, known for its advanced formulas and high standards in the reptile equipment industry.
